preconDecks.metaDescription: Official sealed champion decks for Riftbound — retail preconstructed decks. Unleashed, Origins, and Spiritforged (Fiora, Rumble) champion decks.
preconDecks.title: Precon decks
preconDecks.intro: Riot offers players several ways into the trading card game, and premade champion decks are among the most popular: you can start playing without building a deck from scratch. They are designed to be balanced and approachable for newcomers, and work well as a first deck. We will continue to add decks here as new products are released.
preconDecks.vexBattlefields: Battlefields: Amateur Recital, Gardens of Becoming, Ripper's Bay
preconDecks.vexChampions: Champion unit options: Vex Apathetic, Cheerless, or Mocking (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.vexCardsNote: Main deck includes signature cards such as Mutated Mouser, Existential Dread, Soul Sword, Wuju Apprentice, and more — see the official list for exact quantities.
preconDecks.viBattlefields: Battlefields: Trapping Grounds, Star Spring, Valley of Idols
preconDecks.viChampions: Champion unit options: Vi Destructive, Hotheaded, or Peacekeeper (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.viCardsNote: Main deck includes Vault Breaker, Inferna, Crimson Pigeons, Mageseeker Investigator, Xerath Freed, and more — see the official list for exact quantities.
preconDecks.leeSinBattlefields: Battlefields: Targon's Peak, Monastery of Hirana, Grove of the God-Willow
preconDecks.leeSinChampions: Champion unit options: Lee Sin Centered or Udyr Wildman (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.leeSinCardsNote: Main deck includes Pakaa Cub, Wildclaw Shaman, Discipline, Wielder of Water, and more — see the retail list for exact quantities.
preconDecks.jinxBattlefields: Battlefields: Zaun Warrens, Targon's Peak, Reaver's Row
preconDecks.jinxChampions: Champion unit options: Jinx Demolitionist or Vi Destructive (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.jinxCardsNote: Main deck includes Scrapheap, Flame Chompers, Chemtech Enforcer, Brazen Buccaneer, and more — see the retail list for exact quantities.
preconDecks.viktorBattlefields: Battlefields: Trifarian War Camp, The Grand Plaza, Altar to Unity
preconDecks.viktorChampions: Champion unit options: Viktor Innovator or Heimerdinger Inventor (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.viktorLegend: Legend: Viktor, Herald of the Arcane
preconDecks.viktorCardsNote: Main deck includes Ravenbloom Student, Consult the Past, Eager Apprentice, and more — see the retail list for exact quantities.
preconDecks.rumbleBattlefields: Battlefields: Ravenbloom Conservatory, Treasure Hoard, Minefield
preconDecks.rumbleChampions: Champion unit options: Rumble Scrapper or Rumble Hotheaded (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.rumbleCardsNote: Mech synergy main deck with Production Surge, Void Seeker, and more — see the Riot Spiritforged announcement for the full list.
preconDecks.fioraBattlefields: Battlefields: Ornn's Forge, Veiled Temple, Sunken Temple
preconDecks.fioraChampions: Champion unit options: Fiora Worthy or Fiora Peerless (choose one per deck rules).
preconDecks.fioraCardsNote: Equipment and combat tricks with Strike Down, Warmog's Armor, and more — see the Riot Spiritforged announcement for the full list.

admin.name: Name
admin.homeSubtitle: Internal tools for the catalog, card images, and market prices. Pick a function below — each page explains what it does and how to use the options.
admin.homeCardsDesc: Browse, view, and edit catalog cards (scraper ID, set, rarity, etc.).
admin.homeTcgDesc: Match cards to TCGplayer and refresh USD prices used in the app.
admin.homeBumpDesc: Increment the catalog version so clients know data changed (often after ETL or imports).
admin.homeLoadDesc: Load or update cards from the server’s catalog pipeline (JSON source on the backend).
admin.homeReconcileDesc: Reconcile Riot gallery images with Cloudflare R2 and image_url in the database.
admin.homeCommunitiesDesc: Create and edit communities (name, description, photo URL; URL slug is derived from the name). Users join and leave from public pages.
admin.communitiesSubtitle: Create and edit communities here. Admins only. Membership is managed on public pages.
admin.communitiesSlugAutoHint: The URL slug is generated from the name (no accents, lowercase, spaces become _). If taken, the server appends numeric suffixes (_2, _3…).
admin.communitiesAvatarClearHint: Save with an empty field to remove the image.
admin.communitiesAvatarUploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF up to 5 MB. The file is uploaded to server storage (R2); the backend must have R2 and a public base URL configured.
admin.communitiesAvatarClientSize: File must be at most 5 MB.
admin.communitiesAvatarClientType: Use PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF.
admin.communitiesErrorR2NotConfigured: R2 storage is not configured on the server.
admin.communitiesErrorR2PublicBaseMissing: Public bucket base URL is missing on the server.
admin.cardsPageLead: Search and filter the card list. Use View for read-only details or Edit to change fields. Requires a unique scraper ID for new cards.
admin.tcgPageSubtitle: Runs the backend job that links catalog cards to TCGplayer products and updates prices.
admin.tcgDocsWhatBody: Calls POST /v1/admin/tcg/sync on the API. The server matches cards, updates USD prices where possible, and reports how many rows were updated or skipped.
admin.tcgDocsParamsBody: No request body. The run can take a while; only one sync may run at a time.
admin.bumpPageSubtitle: Increments the monotonic catalog version used for cache invalidation.
admin.bumpDocsWhatBody: Calls POST /v1/admin/catalog-version/bump. The backend raises the version counter and clears in-memory catalog cache so clients refetch after their next version check.
admin.bumpDocsEffectBody: Use after loading new card data or changing metadata so users don’t keep stale catalog data.
admin.loadPageSubtitle: Imports or updates cards from the backend’s catalog source (e.g. Riot catalog JSON).
admin.loadDocsWhatBody: Calls POST /v1/admin/catalog-version/load. The server merges new rows, skips duplicates where configured, and returns metrics (added, skipped, loaded, etc.).
admin.loadDocsBackendBody: Exact behavior depends on server configuration and the catalog file on the backend.
admin.reconcilePageSubtitle: Gallery fetch, optional upload to R2, and updating image_url rows.
admin.reconcileDocsWhatBody: Calls POST /v1/cards/catalog-version/reconcile-r2-card-images. The job reads the official card gallery, checks objects in the bucket, uploads or rotates images as needed, and updates URLs in the database when you apply (not in preview).
admin.reconcileParamDescPreviewApply: Preview runs with dryRun: only metrics, no writes to R2 or DB. Apply sends dryRun: false and performs uploads and DB updates. Large jobs may time out — use set and per-run limit in batches.
admin.reconcileParamDescSetId: Optional. Restrict processing to one expansion code (e.g. UNL). Omit to process all sets from the gallery pipeline.
admin.reconcileParamDescMaxCards: Optional maximum number of cards to process in this request. Use to slice work and avoid gateway timeouts.
admin.reconcileParamDescPrefix: Object key prefix in the R2 bucket (default on server is often "cards").
admin.reconcileParamDescGalleryUrl: Override the Riot card gallery URL; if empty, the server uses its configured default.
admin.reconcileParamDescConcurrency: Parallel uploads/checks (1–32). Higher can be faster but increases load; default on the server is often 8.
admin.reconcileParamDescNoSkip: When enabled (noSkipExisting), re-uploads even if the object already exists in R2 — useful to fix bad images.
admin.tcgSyncAlreadyRunning: A TCG sync is already running.
admin.catalogVersionLoadSuccessWithMetrics: Incremental update completed: {added} added, {skippedExisting} skipped existing, {loaded} loaded.
admin.reconcileR2Title: Update images (gallery → bucket and URLs in the database)
admin.reconcileR2Lead: Fetches from the Riot gallery, uploads to R2 when needed, and keeps image URLs in sync.
admin.reconcileR2MaxCardsHelp: Recommended to avoid timeouts — run in smaller batches if needed.
admin.reconcileR2NoSkipExisting: Overwrite existing objects in the bucket
admin.reconcileR2SummaryPreview: {uploaded} would be uploaded, {dbUrls} URLs would be updated in the database, {failed} errors.
admin.reconcileR2SummaryApply: {uploaded} uploaded, {dbUrls} URLs updated in the database, {failed} errors.
admin.reconcileR2PartialFailure: Some rows failed — check metrics and samples below.
admin.reconcileR2ApplyConfirm: Apply for real: upload to the bucket and update URLs in the database?
admin.reconcileR2TimeoutHint: Large jobs can time out (especially on serverless). Use set + per-run limit to batch work.
